items.q: Do you just let AI generate a website and deliver it?
items.a: No. AI only improves efficiency for strategy, copy, and initial drafts. All client-facing pages go through human review, design refinement, responsive testing, and launch QA.

items.q: How long does it take to launch?
items.a: Single-page sites typically take 3-7 days, standard business websites 7-14 days, and complex brand growth sites are assessed based on page count and material readiness.

items.q: What materials do I need to prepare?
items.a: We recommend preparing company intro, products/services, target audience, contact info, logo, images, reference websites, and domain/hosting details. The more complete, the faster the delivery.
We don't guarantee specific rankings. We provide basic SEO titles, descriptions, page structure, and indexing recommendations. Ongoing content growth can be assessed separately.

items.q: Can you maintain the site after launch?
items.a: Yes. Maintenance includes hosting, SSL, backups, minor copy edits, form checks, analytics reports, and ongoing optimization suggestions.

hero.title: Get delivery right first, then productize.
hero.subtitle: AI Website Factory is not traditional outsourcing, nor a fully self-service website builder from day one. We use AI and standardized processes to improve team delivery efficiency first, then gradually codify capabilities into a SaaS platform.

positioning.title: Clients need a website that is launchable, maintainable, and growth-ready.
positioning.p1: The core of an early-stage project is not a feature-complete website platform, but a high-quality delivery loop: client intake, AI-generated drafts, human design refinement, one-click preview deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
positioning.p2: Once the repetitive actions in delivery are stable enough, we gradually productize templates, components, prompts, deployment flows, and client portals.
